sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:20

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:20:1
items.html: From these AB and RIU the Mochin of ZA are made: As explained above with respect to the Mochin of the Nukva, so it is also with ZA: by his ascent in the inclusion of the coupling in AVI, AVI — which are AB and SAG — couple in the discernment of face to face; and then the illumination of AB lowers the bottom Hey from the Einayim of Ima, where ZA is included, and then ZA attains his posterior, which are the vessels of Bina and ZON, with their lights of the three ABs, which are RIU in Gematria; and also his Mochin of Gadlut, which are the male AB, as above. And then he is completed and descends to his place. It follows that the Mochin of ZA, too, are the discernments of AB and RIU, bestowed upon him from AVI.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:20:2
items.html: The pure air and the pure fire, etc., and by the power of these two the Daat of ZA is made: Meaning, the discernments of the vessel and the Ruach that raise the MAN, mentioned above, are the secret of the pure air [Avira Dachya], and it includes the five Hassadim, namely, the above illumination of AB, which is the male waters. And the discernment of the MAN of Ima, which is the secret of the five Gevurot, is called the pure fire [Esha Dachya]. And the two of them together are the secret of AB and RIU, from which the Mochin of ZA are made, as I wrote in the adjacent item; study it there well. That is, at the time of his ascent as MAN, for the inclusion of the coupling in AVI, to attain there his Mochin of Gadlut, he then receives from the light of the coupling of AB and SAG, which lowers the bottom Hey from his Einayim, and his AHP return to the degree; and then his NHY of the vessels and GAR of the lights are completed for him, as above. And this coupling is discerned as being in the vessels of AVI; therefore those NHY that ascended to complete the stature of the ten Sefirot of the Gadlut of ZA are connected in the vessels of AVI, since the coupling is made in the NHY of AVI, only from the aspect of externality, which is the degree of ZA. Therefore those new NHY that were added by the force of the coupling in AVI are discerned: the vessels are those of AVI themselves, but the stature of the light is the stature of ZA, since the coupling was made upon the MAN of ZA. Therefore, after ZA is born, he takes with him the above NHY of AVI, because the stature of the light in them is not of the degree of AVI but of the degree of ZA, and they clothe in the discernment of the internality of ZA, in the discernment of garments of Mochin (as I expanded above, page 637, the passage beginning “Now you will understand”; study it there well). And this is what he says, “And by the power of these two the Daat of ZA is made”: namely, from the discernments of the Yesodot of AVI a garment is made for the Daat of ZA, and in them are the pure air and the pure fire. And from the discernment of the NH of AVI, in which are the GAR, namely, the above male AB, they are the discernments of HB of ZA, and the NH are the garments of this HB — for the NH are the discernments of the GAR, and the Yesod is the discernment of ZA, as is known. Therefore the discernments of the pure fire and the pure air clothe in the Yesod, since they are of the discernment of the above RIU; and the discernment of the male AB, which is the discernment of the GAR — HB — clothes in the NH.
